heading: Loan rates for nonrecourse marketing assistance loans

tree.heading: 2002 and 2003 crop years
tree.text: For purposes of the 2002 and 2003 crop years, the loan rate for a marketing assistance loan under section 7931 of this title for a loan commodity shall be equal to the following:

children.text: In the case of wheat, $2.80 per bushel.
In the case of corn, $1.98 per bushel.
In the case of grain sorghum, $1.98 per bushel.
In the case of barley, $1.88 per bushel.
In the case of oats, $1.35 per bushel.
In the case of upland cotton, $0.52 per pound.
In the case of extra long staple cotton, $0.7977 per pound.
In the case of rice, $6.50 per hundredweight.
In the case of soybeans, $5.00 per bushel.
In the case of other oilseeds, $.0960 per pound for each of the following kinds of oilseeds:
Sunflower seed.
Rapeseed.
Canola.
Safflower.
Flaxseed.
Mustard seed.
Crambe.
Sesame seed.
Other oilseeds designated by the Secretary.
In the case of graded wool, $1.00 per pound.
In the case of nongraded wool, $0.40 per pound.
In the case of mohair, $4.20 per pound.
In the case of honey, $0.60 per pound.
In the case of dry peas, $6.33 per hundredweight.
In the case of lentils, $11.94 per hundredweight.
In the case of small chickpeas, $7.56 per hundredweight.

tree.heading: 2004 through 2007 crop years
tree.text: For purposes of the 2004 through 2007 crop years, the loan rate for a marketing assistance loan under section 7931 of this title for a loan commodity shall be equal to the following:

children.text: In the case of wheat, $2.75 per bushel.
In the case of corn, $1.95 per bushel.
In the case of grain sorghum, $1.95 per bushel.
In the case of barley, $1.85 per bushel.
In the case of oats, $1.33 per bushel.
In the case of upland cotton, $0.52 per pound.
In the case of extra long staple cotton, $0.7977 per pound.
In the case of rice, $6.50 per hundredweight.
In the case of soybeans, $5.00 per bushel.
In the case of other oilseeds, $.0930 per pound for each of the following kinds of oilseeds:
Sunflower seed.
Rapeseed.
Canola.
Safflower.
Flaxseed.
Mustard seed.
Crambe.
Sesame seed.
Other oilseeds designated by the Secretary.
In the case of graded wool, $1.00 per pound.
In the case of nongraded wool, $0.40 per pound.
In the case of mohair, $4.20 per pound.
In the case of honey, $0.60 per pound.
In the case of dry peas, $6.22 per hundredweight.
In the case of lentils, $11.72 per hundredweight.
In the case of small chickpeas, $7.43 per hundredweight.

tree.heading: Single county loan rate for other oilseeds
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish a single loan rate in each county for each kind of other oilseeds described in subsections (a)(10) and (b)(10).

tree.heading: Quality grades for dry peas, lentils, and small chickpeas
tree.text: The loan rate for dry peas, lentils, and small chickpeas shall be based on—

children.text: in the case of dry peas, United States feed peas;
in the case of lentils, United States number 3 lentils; and
in the case of small chickpeas, United States number 3 small chickpeas that drop below a 20/64 screen.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2003—Subsec. (a)(10). Pub. L. 108–7, § 763(b)(1), added par. (10) and struck out former par. (10) which read as follows: “In the case of other oilseeds, $0.0960 per pound.” Subsec. (b)(10). Pub. L. 108–7, § 763(b)(2), added par. (10) and struck out former par. (10) which read as follows: “In the case of other oilseeds, $0.0930 per pound.” Subsecs. (c), (d). Pub. L. 108–7, § 763(b)(3), added subsecs. (c) and (d).

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2003 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 108–7 applicable beginning with the 2003 crop of other oilseeds, dry peas, lentils, and small chickpeas, see section 763(d) of Pub. L. 108–7, set out as a note under section 7901 of this title.
